args.title: Saltmarsh Foods: Warehouse automation in 2026 (newsletter + companion)
args.body:
Sources: Saltmarsh Foods newsletter "Warehouse automation in 2026" (newsletter@saltmarsh.example); linked article at blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/warehouse; companion piece at insights.saltmarsh.example/warehouse/companion.

- Autonomous carts drove an 18% increase in warehouse pick rates in 2026, making throughput the headline gain.
- Implementation was the weak point: integration took roughly twice as long as planned, a schedule/budget risk to factor into any automation business case.
- Per the companion piece, the largest cost saving came from fewer mis-picks (accuracy) rather than from raw picking speed — so quality/error reduction may be the stronger ROI argument.
